name: Seishi Jidou Hanbaiki no Seinen
original_name: 精子自動販売機の青年
source:
The sad, bizarre story of a sperm vendor.

Sad but also funny.

Comedic and surreal.

Erotic scenes have breathing voice effects.

The rest of the novel is up to your imagination.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE142144.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
一个精子小贩的悲伤而离奇的故事。

悲伤但也很有趣。

喜剧和超现实。

色情场景有呼吸声音效果。

小说的其余部分取决于你的想象力。

[来自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE142144.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
